intended_object: The forgetful functor from the category of DG right modules over a DG algebra (A, d) over a commutative ring R to the category of R-modules. It sends a DG module to its underlying R-module and a morphism to its underlying R-linear map. Inferred from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation: On objects the functor gives `ModuleCat.of R M`, the underlying R-module of the carrier. On morphisms it takes the underlying Aᵐᵒᵖ-linear map and restricts scalars to R, which is legitimate because of `IsScalarTower R Aᵐᵒᵖ M`. The functor laws are proved from the identity and composition lemmas for `DGRightModuleHom`. This is exactly the standard forgetful functor that drops the grading, the differential and the algebra action. The setting (DG right modules over a ℤ-graded DG algebra over a commutative ring) is the one the library defines its category in, and the functor needs nothing more specific. Mathlib has no DG-module category, so it has no counterpart for this functor.
